title: Copilot4D: Learning Unsupervised World Models for Autonomous Driving via Discrete Diffusion

output_modality.value: lidar point clouds (future point cloud forecasting), via BEV tokens decoded to rays/depth

control_signal.value: future ego-vehicle SE(3) poses as actions, plus past observations and actions as context

control_mechanism.value: discrete diffusion world model conditioned on past tokens and actions; classifier-free guidance at sampling, using an unconditional objective trained on 10% of iterations

base_model.value: VQVAE point-cloud tokenizer (PointNet, Swin, implicit depth-rendering decoder) plus MaskGIT-style discrete diffusion with a spatio-temporal Transformer (Swin spatial, GPT2 temporal blocks, U-Net); no pretrained video backbone stated

datasets.value: NuScenes, KITTI Odometry, Argoverse2 Lidar; zero-shot transfer from Argoverse2 to KITTI

metrics.value: Chamfer distance, L1 depth (mean and median), AbsRel (mean and median) within the ROI of 70m by 70m by 4.5m half-extents

controllability_evidence.value: Mostly forecasting accuracy: Chamfer reduced 65%-75% for 1s and more than 50% for 3s versus prior SOTA. Counterfactual ego-action visualisations are qualitative only; CFG cuts Chamfer by 60% on NuScenes 3s.

closed_loop.value: no; open-loop prediction of 1s or 3s futures, autoregressive frame by frame, with no driving policy in the loop

stated_limitations.value: 3s vehicle behaviour accuracy is lower than 1s, partly from multi-modality; the model does not hallucinate new vehicles entering the region of interest.

notes: Unsupervised point-cloud forecasting world model; control is only ego poses (counterfactual actions shown qualitatively), not a designer-facing control input like layout or text. Classifier-free guidance here is on past context, not on a control signal.
